decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed two storey side extension and roof extension, by way of its position, size, scale and appearance, has due regard for the sites' characteristics and the dynamics of the surrounding built environment and would not be detrimental to the amenity of the adjoining properties or the immediate locality.  The development is therefore in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant no undue adverse effects would result.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western sidewall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of two storey side extension and roof extension to dwellinghouse.
